ui.title: Clay Garden
ui.subtitle: Arrange the items so the garden feels cozy: each one likes some neighbors and dislikes others.
ui.card.name: {slot} · {name}
ui.result.need_first:
Coziness {score} — the first star needs {need}.
Rearrange the items: right-click takes them back into your hand.
ui.result.need_first_touch:
Coziness {score} — the first star needs {need}.
Rearrange the items: hold your finger on an item to take it back into your hand.
ui.result.beyond: Wow — better than the best garden the solver found!
ui.result.ideal: Perfect — it can't be arranged any better!
ui.result.chapter_stars: {chapter}: ★ {n} of {need} to open the next chapter
ui.corner.season_locked: Autumn and winter unlock in the campaign
ui.help.level_touch:
Tap a cell — try the item (you see how much coziness it adds), tap it again — place it
Tap an item and the trash, or hold on it — back to your hand
The arrow undoes the last move
Drag — turn the island, pinch — zoom
ui.help.sandbox_touch:
Tap — place an item or use the tool
Tap an item and the trash, or hold on it — remove
The arrow undoes the last move
Drag — turn the island, pinch — zoom
ui.help.title: How to play
coach.aim: You're trying it out: see how much coziness it adds. Tap the same cell again to place it
coach.place: Changed your mind? Tap the item, then the trash — it goes back to your hand. The arrow undoes
coach.sandbox: Tap to place, drag to turn the island, pinch to zoom. Tap an item, then the trash, to remove it
ui.about.handmade: Models, music, sounds and the icon are generated by the game's own code — no borrowed images or sounds.
ui.about.legal_note: Legal texts are given in their original language.
ui.reset.title: Reset progress?
ui.reset.lose: You'll lose your stars ({stars} of {max}) and crowns ({crowns}). This can't be undone.
ui.reset.keep: Your free garden, language and sound settings will stay.
ui.reset.none: No progress yet — nothing to reset.
toast.reset: Progress reset. Your garden is still here.
toast.garden_locked: Autumn and winter will open again in the campaign — summer garden for now
ui.year.tip: Show the garden in this season (Tab — next)
ui.hud.title: Level {slot} · {name}
ui.help.sandbox:
Left click — place (you can drag)
Right click — remove
R — rotate fence and bench
Q / E — turn the island by 90°, middle drag or a drag off the island — turn freely
wheel — zoom
1…9, 0 — pick, T — fast time
Y — season, M — sound, F12 — screenshot
H — hide, Esc — menu
mech.winter: Winter is here! The water froze — “water nearby” no longer counts, but stones and benches love the rink. The trees are bare and no longer crowd each other.
mech.snow: Snowdrifts! An item on a snowdrift freezes and gives nothing unless a lantern or campfire is within 2 steps.
mech.drought: Drought! Cells more than 2 steps from water are dry — flowers there give nothing.
mech.line: The fence learned something new: a row of 3+ fences gives +1 to each.
mech.leaf_fall: Falling leaves! Pumpkins now like being under trees: tree +1 instead of −1.
toast.sandbox: Free garden: sculpt whatever you like
toast.fixed: This item has always been here — it can't be moved
toast.trash_pick: Tap an item first, then the trash
toast.water_level: Water runs down to its lowest bank
toast.pond_low: A pond rises only when all the land around it is higher
hint.between: {v} if a tree or fir goes here
card.view: View: {v} if the cell is higher than all its neighbors
card.thirst: Drought: on a dry cell (water farther than 2 steps) — 0 points
card.cap: {items} nearby: {v}, but no more than {max} times
card.frozen: The water is frozen: “water nearby” doesn't count in winter
card.freezes: Freezes on a snowdrift (0) unless a lantern or campfire is within 2 steps
level.first_sprouts.name: First Flowers
level.first_sprouts.hint: Flowers love water and other flowers. Neighbors are the four cells around a tile.
level.small_pond.name: A Small Pond
level.small_pond.hint: The pond is small, so not everyone fits by the water. The other flowers are happier together.
level.first_bush.name: The First Bush
level.first_bush.hint: A bush likes flowers nearby. Flowers still want water and friends.
level.narrow_bed.name: A Narrow Bed
level.narrow_bed.hint: Space is tight: the flowers want both the water and each other.
level.windy_bushes.name: Bushes in the Wind
level.windy_bushes.hint: Bushes like flowers next to them. Make it nice for the flowers too.
level.morning.name: Morning in the Garden
level.morning.hint: Flowers go to the water and to each other. Let the bush bask beside the flowers.
level.shade.name: The First Tree
level.shade.hint: A tree loves bushes around it. Plant them so the tree feels at home.
level.two_apple_trees.name: Two Apple Trees
level.two_apple_trees.hint: Two trees side by side feel cramped. Give each one its own bushes.
level.snowdrops.name: Snowdrops
level.snowdrops.hint: Snowdrops hide by the bushes and reach for the water. Under a tree they feel cold.
level.two_groves.name: Two Little Groves
level.two_groves.hint: Think about the trees first: keep them apart, and both of them need bushes.
level.brook.name: The Brook
level.brook.hint: A brook runs across the island. Flowers and snowdrops are happy on its banks.
level.warm_stones.name: Warm Stones
level.warm_stones.hint: Stones warm up by the water and like to lie together.
level.stone_by_brook.name: A Stone by the Brook
level.stone_by_brook.hint: Stones want the water, snowdrops want the bushes.
level.tight_glade.name: A Tight Glade
level.tight_glade.hint: Not a cell to spare. Snowdrops feel cold under the trees.
level.lilies.name: Water Lilies
level.lilies.hint: Water lilies go only on water. They like flowers on the bank.
level.quiet_bank.name: The Quiet Bank
level.quiet_bank.hint: Stones, lilies and snowdrops — everyone needs a bit of the shore.
level.forest_edge.name: The Forest Edge
level.forest_edge.hint: Trees, bushes and snowdrops: each one has its favorite neighbor.
level.first_pines.name: First Firs
level.first_pines.hint: Firs like to grow together. A tree next to a fir feels uneasy.
level.orchard.name: The Orchard
level.orchard.hint: Four trees on a tight island. Keep them apart.
level.sprouts.name: Rooted Here
level.sprouts.hint: A tree already grows here and can't be moved. Build the garden around it.
level.mushroom_spot.name: Mushroom Spot
level.mushroom_spot.hint: Mushrooms hide in the shade of firs and trees.
level.first_bed.name: Grow Where Planted
level.first_bed.hint: Flowers love other flowers and water. Neighbors are the four cells around a tile.
level.starlings.name: The Birdhouse
level.starlings.hint: Starlings settle by trees. Two birdhouses side by side will quarrel.
level.shady_corner.name: A Shady Nook
level.shady_corner.hint: A tree is glad of bushes, but two trees side by side feel cramped.
level.spring_garden.name: Spring Awakening
level.spring_garden.hint: Everything that bloomed this spring: birdhouses by the trees, snowdrops by the bushes.
level.bench_view.name: A Bench with a View
level.bench_view.hint: A bench is happy up on a hill — there's a view from there. And by water and flowers too.
level.hill_bench.name: King of the Hill
level.hill_bench.hint: Give the bench a hill with a view, water and flowers nearby. The tree loves bushes and flowers.
level.starling_grove.name: Starling Grove
level.starling_grove.hint: Starlings get the trees, snowdrops get the bushes. Just don't make the starlings neighbors.
level.pond_benches.name: Benches by the Pond
level.pond_benches.hint: Every bench wants a view, water or flowers. Space is short, choose wisely.
level.lake_view.name: Lake View
level.lake_view.hint: The bench needs a view and water; the lilies need flowers on the bank.
level.first_lantern.name: The First Lantern
level.first_lantern.hint: A lantern loves benches nearby, and a bench is cosy under a lantern. Two lanterns side by side are too bright.
level.lanterns_mushrooms.name: Lights and Mushrooms
level.lanterns_mushrooms.hint: Benches are happy under lanterns, but mushrooms don't care for the light.
level.fir_grove.name: Dark Woods
level.fir_grove.hint: Firs love other firs, mushrooms hide in their shade. Mushrooms don't like lantern light.
level.fence_line.name: The Fence
level.fence_line.hint: A fence likes the fence next to it and bushes. A lantern is happy by the fence too.
level.evening_alley.name: Lanterns at Dusk
level.evening_alley.hint: A bench is happy under a lantern and up on a hill with a view. Two lanterns side by side are too bright.
level.drought.name: Drought
level.drought.hint: It's hot! Flowers more than two steps from water dry up and give nothing — look for the cracks.
level.dry_meadow.name: High Noon
level.dry_meadow.hint: Drought: there's little room by the pond and lots of flowers. Who gets the water?
level.beehive.name: The Beehive
level.beehive.hint: Bees need flowers around them — within two steps, diagonals too. Find the spot that sees every flower.
level.bee_glade.name: Bee Glade
level.bee_glade.hint: Beehives see flowers two steps away — even dry ones. But the flowers themselves give nothing without water.
level.hot_apiary.name: Apiary in the Heat
level.hot_apiary.hint: Drought, bees and a bench under a lantern: water for the flowers, flowers for the beehives.
level.hammock.name: The Hammock
level.hammock.hint: Two trees already grow here. String a hammock between them — the supports must be on opposite sides.
level.quiet_pond.name: Still Waters
level.quiet_pond.hint: Stones and flowers reach for the water, lilies like flowers on the bank.
level.forest_hammock.name: Hammock in the Woods
level.forest_hammock.hint: A hammock needs two supports facing each other — trees or firs.
level.hammock_bridge.name: Hammocks over the Bridge
level.hammock_bridge.hint: Two hammocks, lots of trees and a tight island.
level.forest_rest.name: A Rest in the Woods
level.forest_rest.hint: A hammock between firs, mushrooms in the shade of trees — everything the forest loves.
level.hot_noon.name: Dog Days
level.hot_noon.hint: A beehive sees dry flowers too — but they give nothing themselves without water.
level.bee_evening.name: Bees at Sunset
level.bee_evening.hint: Beehives love flowers, benches dislike a beehive next door, lanterns go to the benches.
level.two_ponds.name: Two Ponds
level.two_ponds.hint: Plenty of water but few lilies — pick which shore to decorate.
level.hills.name: Hills
level.hills.hint: Find hilltops for the benches and shade for the mushrooms. The stones are already here and can't be moved.
level.summer_garden.name: Height of Summer
level.summer_garden.hint: Drought, bees and benches — all of summer at once.
level.pumpkins.name: Pumpkins
level.pumpkins.hint: Pumpkins need a fence nearby and other pumpkins. Under a tree it's too dark for them.
level.kitchen_garden.name: Sunny Patch
level.kitchen_garden.hint: Pumpkins need a fence, and under a tree it's too dark for them.
level.fence_rows.name: The Boundary
level.fence_rows.hint: Fences in a straight row, pumpkins by the fence, bushes next to trees.
level.straight_fence.name: A Straight Fence
level.straight_fence.hint: A row of three or more fences — +1 for each. Build it straight, not zigzag.
level.garden_trial.name: Trial: The Big Patch
level.garden_trial.hint: Pumpkins, fences and birdhouses by the trees — the vegetable patch trial.
level.scarecrow.name: The Scarecrow
level.scarecrow.hint: A scarecrow guards the pumpkins around it — two steps, diagonals too. Each pumpkin near it gets +1.
level.tight_island.name: A Tight Island
level.tight_island.hint: Not a cell to spare: find everyone their best neighbor.
level.guarded_field.name: The Bodyguard
level.guarded_field.hint: The scarecrow protects the pumpkins, but the starlings fear it — who lives where?
level.crowded_field.name: A Crowded Field
level.crowded_field.hint: Space is short, and the scarecrow has to reach every pumpkin.
level.scarecrow_trial.name: Trial: Scarecrow Garden
level.scarecrow_trial.hint: Scarecrow, birds, pumpkins and fence — everything from this chapter.
level.leaf_fall.name: Falling Leaves
level.leaf_fall.hint: The leaves are falling! Pumpkins now like being under a tree — the leaves keep them warm.
level.under_leaves.name: Under the Leaves
level.under_leaves.hint: Falling leaves: pumpkins now love trees. And the scarecrow still guards them.
level.forest_evening.name: Forest Evening
level.forest_evening.hint: Hammocks, benches under lanterns and mushrooms in the shade — it's tight, think it through.
level.leaf_guard.name: Leaves and Scarecrow
level.leaf_guard.hint: Falling leaves: pumpkins are glad of trees. The scarecrow guards them, fences go in a straight row.
level.big_garden.name: The Big Garden
level.big_garden.hint: Everything you've learned, all at once. No rush — you can always take an item back into your hand.
level.haystack.name: The Haystack
level.haystack.hint: A haystack likes pumpkins and fence nearby, but counts no more than two neighbors.
level.first_stacks.name: First Haystacks
level.first_stacks.hint: Haystacks want pumpkins and fence nearby — but no more than two neighbors.
level.stack_row.name: Haystacks by the Fence
level.stack_row.hint: A long straight fence, pumpkins and haystacks: who goes next to whom?
level.autumn_rest.name: Trial: Autumn Rest
level.autumn_rest.hint: Hammocks, benches, lanterns and mushrooms — the chapter trial.
level.stack_puzzle.name: Haystacks and Starlings
level.stack_puzzle.hint: Haystacks get pumpkins and fence, starlings get trees. Not a cell to spare.
level.harvest_morning.name: Harvest Morning
level.harvest_morning.hint: Pumpkins, fence, scarecrow and haystack — everything autumn knows.
level.harvest_evening.name: Harvest Evening
level.harvest_evening.hint: Everything autumn knows, on one island.
level.hay_harvest.name: Haymaking
level.hay_harvest.hint: Haystacks need pumpkins and fence nearby — but no more than two neighbors.
level.harvest_puzzle.name: A Tight Harvest
level.harvest_puzzle.hint: Pumpkins, haystacks, a straight fence and starlings — a place for everyone.
level.harvest.name: Harvest Festival
level.harvest.hint: Autumn finale: haystacks, pumpkins, fences, birdhouses and snowdrops.
level.winter_came.name: The First Snowman
level.winter_came.hint: The pond froze into a skating rink. A snowman is happy on the ice and next to a fir; stones like the rink.
level.skating_rink.name: The Skating Rink
level.skating_rink.hint: The snowman goes on the ice, benches go to the rink and the lantern. Bare winter trees don't quarrel.
level.three_snowmen.name: Three Snowmen
level.three_snowmen.hint: The snowmen want the ice, but the lantern would melt them — keep it aside, by the bench.
level.snowdrifts.name: Snowdrifts
level.snowdrifts.hint: It's cold on a snowdrift — without a lantern within two steps, an item freezes. Snowmen don't mind the frost.
level.one_lantern.name: A Single Lantern
level.one_lantern.hint: One lantern, many snowdrifts: decide who to warm. Snowdrops like bushes, birdhouses like a tree.
level.campfire.name: The Campfire
level.campfire.hint: A campfire warms the snowdrifts and gathers benches around it. But a snowman melts by the fire.
level.fireside.name: Fireside
level.fireside.hint: Benches go to the fire, snowmen stay away from it — on the ice or a snowdrift.
level.winter_yard.name: Winter Yard
level.winter_yard.hint: A long fence, a haystack by the fence, benches by the fire. The snowman gets the cold corner of the yard.
level.crowded_glade.name: A Crowded Glade
level.crowded_glade.hint: There isn't warmth for every snowdrift: place fires and lanterns so their diamonds don't overlap.
level.long_evening.name: Trial: A Long Evening
level.long_evening.hint: One campfire and four lanterns warm the snowdrifts, benches gather by the fire, and the snowman needs a cold corner.
level.feeder.name: The Bird Feeder
level.feeder.hint: Hang the feeder by firs and trees. A birdhouse next to it is nice too.
level.bird_canteen.name: The Bird Canteen
level.bird_canteen.hint: Feeders go to the firs, but not right next to a fire: birds don't like smoke.
level.bare_wood.name: Bare Woods
level.bare_wood.hint: Six bare trees don't quarrel in winter. A feeder likes a fir, trees and a birdhouse next to it.
level.four_fires.name: Four Fires
level.four_fires.hint: Lots of fires, and feeders don't like them. Find a cold corner for the birds and snowmen.
level.winter_birds.name: Trial: Winter Birds
level.winter_birds.hint: Feeders by the trees, birdhouses next to them, benches by the fire — and nobody freezing on a snowdrift.
level.winter_garden_walk.name: Winter Wonderland
level.winter_garden_walk.hint: A rink, firs, benches by the fire and a snowman far from the warmth.
level.farmstead.name: The Farmstead
level.farmstead.hint: Fences in a row, a haystack by the fence, feeders by the trees. One fire — let it warm the snowdrifts.
level.fire_and_snow.name: Fire and Snow
level.fire_and_snow.hint: Snowdrifts need fires, but snowmen melt by them: put them at opposite ends.
level.five_feeders.name: Five Feeders
level.five_feeders.hint: A fire warms two steps around, but a feeder right next to it is unhappy — keep your distance.
level.winter_garden_trial.name: Trial: Winter Garden
level.winter_garden_trial.hint: The whole garden under snow: one fire for the snowdrifts, a fence row with a haystack, snowdrops by the bushes.
level.year_round.name: Year After Year
level.year_round.hint: One garden for the whole year: water in summer, ice in winter; pumpkins like trees in autumn, trees are bare in winter.
level.four_times.name: Four Seasons
level.four_times.hint: The beehive and flowers are happy in summer, the fire and feeders in winter. One garden: let someone be happy every season (Tab — view seasons).
level.four_times.hint_touch: The beehive and flowers are happy in summer, the fire and feeders in winter. One garden: let someone be happy every season (switch seasons with the buttons at the top).
level.hammock_till_snow.name: A Hammock Until the Snow
level.hammock_till_snow.hint: Hammocks between trees in summer, a feeder by the firs in winter, a scarecrow guarding pumpkins all year. One garden for the whole year.
level.longest_year.name: The Longest Year
level.longest_year.hint: Lilies bloom in summer and freeze in winter, the snowman melts by the fire, mushrooms dislike the lantern. The hardest garden of the year.
level.year_feast.name: Happy Holidays
level.year_feast.hint: The whole year in one garden: a snowdrop in spring, a hive in summer, a scarecrow in autumn, a snowman in winter. Happy holidays!
